name: Grace Communion International (formerly Worldwide Church of God)

citations.excerpt: Grace Communion International began in 2009 as a reorganization of the Worldwide Church of God, which was originally founded in the early 1930s by Herbert Armstrong.
originally founded in the early 1930s by Herbert Armstrong.

facts.value: After Armstrong's death in 1986 the church changed its doctrines, lost about a third of its members to splinter groups, and now agrees with the National Association of Evangelicals.

citations.excerpt: After Armstrong's death in 1986, the organization began to change its doctrines
The organization is now in full agreement with the National Association of Evangelicals.
Almost a third of the group's membership was lost during this transition, as many of the members aligned with Armstrong's teachings left to form splinter groups.
